parent_prompt:

Image 5 is a finished background painting from our game: use it ONLY as the reference for the painting technique (brushwork, palette, edge softness, level of detail, line quality); do not copy anything from its scene.

Brief: an autumn afternoon in a family-house garage: a table with a radio being repaired on the left, small-parts drawers on the right, a fabric bag on a chair. The place feels lived-in, not like a secret laboratory. Thursday 29 October 2020, warm low sunlight falling in through the open door onto the floor, dust motes in the light.

Camera: standing inside a wide double garage, about 2.2 m high, looking straight at its long front wall with the open door; the wall is parallel to the picture and fills the whole picture up to the top edge - the ceiling is NOT visible, only a dark beam along the very top edge; no side walls. Interactive props - each painted clearly inside its block, the same size as its block, easy to recognise at a glance:
